service.description: A task for the user or someone else (assignToPartyId, default the user's party), owned by the user, due on estimatedCompletionDate, on the record in context.

A scheduled next action on the record in context (Chatter's activity; an activity is always on a record): a call, email or to-do is a task (create#SimpleTask, purpose WepPhoneCall, WepEmail or WepToDo) due at dueDate; a meeting is an event (mantle.work.EventServices.create#Event, purpose WepMeeting) from dueDate to endDate (30 minutes by default) in the user's default calendar. Assigned to assignToPartyId (default the user), with the note in description. The record's followers of activities are notified (link#WorkEffortRecord notifyFollowers), linked to recordUrl when given (Chatter's host page) or else the record's Commons screen.

return.message: An activity is a call, an email, a to-do or a meeting, not ${activityType}

service-call.name: mantle.work.EventServices.create#Event

service.description: An event from estimatedStartDate to estimatedCompletionDate (an hour by default), or all day on those days, in calendarId (the user's default calendar by default), with the user assigned and the attendees invited (WorkEffortParty WeptOffered and mantle.work.EventServices.send#EventInvitations; an invitation that fails is logged and the event stays), on the record in context. With attendees it is a meeting (WepMeeting).

parameter.name: allDay
parameter.description: Y for an all-day event (allDayStart and allDayEnd)

service.description: A note. On the record in context it is a note on its Chatter (log#RecordNote, a Comment communication event filed on the record), rich text (HTML, the rich-light editor) whose @ mentions (data-mention-id, a party) are notified; without one it is a page of the user's private notes space, markdown (org.moqui.impl.WikiServices.ensure#UserNotesSpace, made on first use, then update#WikiPage), named for the title (a new name when a page has it already).

parameter.name: contentType
parameter.description: text/html for the rich text of a note on a record (the default there), text/markdown otherwise

service-call.name: mantle.party.CommunicationServices.log#RecordNote

service.description: A person or an organization. By default a personal contact (mantle.party.ContactBookServices create#PersonalContact) in contactBookId or the user's default book, seen only by the user; with contactBookId DIRECTORY a directory party (store#ContactParty with the role Contact for a person or Account for an organization, owned by the active organization when one is active). A person's name is split at its last space into first and last name. The phone is digits: ten are the area code and number, one more is the country code.

parameter.name: contactBookId
parameter.description: A book, DIRECTORY, or empty for the default book

service-call.name: mantle.party.ContactBookServices.create#PersonalContact
service-call.in-map: Object.assign({ contactBookId:contactBookId, partyTypeEnumId:contact.partyTypeEnumId, firstName:contact.firstName, lastName:contact.lastName, organizationName:contact.organizationName, organizationPartyId:contact.organizationPartyId, emailAddress:emailAddress}, phoneParts || {})

set.from: ec.resource.expand(isDirectory ? 'Contact added to the directory: ${name}' : 'Contact added: ${name}', '', {name:contactName})

service.description: A request filed by the user and submitted (mantle.request.RequestServices.create#Request), with its customer (the party in context by default); on the record in context through link#RequestRecord (a work effort through RequestWorkEffort, a wiki page through WikiPageRequest, any other record through RequestRecord).
Puts a new work effort on the record in context, when there is one (link#WorkEffortRecord).
